```json
{
  "tests": [
    {
      "name": "single argument",
      "given": "args=['NAME'], stdin=empty, stdout=ok, stderr=ok",
      "expect": "result=0, stdout='', stderr=''",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "happy"
    },
    {
      "name": "multiple arguments",
      "given": "args=['NAME', 'EXTRA'], stdin=empty, stdout=ok, stderr=ok",
      "expect": "result=2, stdout='', stderr='usage: hello [NAME]'",
      "polarity": "negative",
      "covers": "boundary"
    },
    {
      "name": "no arguments",
      "given": "args=[], stdin=empty, stdout=ok, stderr=ok",
      "expect": "result=0, stdout='', stderr=''",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "boundary"
    }
  ]
}
```

```go
package cli

import (
	"bytes"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRun(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name       string
		args       []string
		stdin      func() io.Reader
		wantResult int
		wantStdout string
		wantStderr string
	}{
		{
			name: "single argument",
			args: []string{"NAME"},
			stdin: func() io.Reader {
				return strings.NewReader("")
			},
			wantResult: 0,
			wantStdout: "",
			wantStderr: "",
		},
		{
			name: "multiple arguments",
			args: []string{"NAME", "EXTRA"},
			stdin: func() io.Reader {
				return strings.NewReader("")
			},
			wantResult: 2,
			wantStdout: "",
			wantStderr: "usage: hello [NAME]",
		},
		{
			name: "no arguments",
			args: []string{},
			stdin: func() io.Reader {
				return strings.NewReader("")
			},
			wantResult: 0,
			wantStdout: "",
			wantStderr: "",
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(strings.ReplaceAll(tt.name, " ", "_"), func(t *testing.T) {
			stdout := &bytes.Buffer{}
			stderr := &bytes.Buffer{}
			stdin := tt.stdin()

			gotResult := Run(tt.args, stdin, stdout, stderr)

			if gotResult != tt.wantResult {
				t.Errorf("Run() gotResult = %v, want %v", gotResult, tt.wantResult)
			}
			if stdout.String() != tt.wantStdout {
				t.Errorf("Run() stdout = %q, want %q", stdout.String(), tt.wantStdout)
			}
			if stderr.String() != tt.wantStderr {
				t.Errorf("Run() stderr = %q, want %q", stderr.String(), tt.wantStderr)
			}
		})
	}
}
```
